page.heading: Wi-Fi that reaches every desk
body: Slow or patchy networks are rarely about internet speed. Usually it is an old switch, a firewall nobody has updated, or access points placed where it was easy to run a cable.

We survey the office first and map Wi-Fi coverage room by room. Then we design the network: business firewall, switches, and access points where people actually sit. Guest Wi-Fi stays separate from staff and from anything that holds client data.
Installs happen after hours. Every cable and port is labelled and documented, so the next fix takes minutes instead of an afternoon of tracing wires.
Once it is in, we keep the firewall patched, watch the network for faults, and replace hardware before it fails. Several offices can be joined so they work like one.
page.plans: Day-to-day support in every plan. Multi-site management in Complete. New installs are quoted as a project.

faq.q: Can you reuse our existing equipment?
faq.a: Often, yes. We test what you have and only replace the parts that are old, unsupported or in the wrong place.
No. We install after hours or over a weekend and test every desk before staff come back.

faq.q: Do you help with an office move?
faq.a: Yes. We plan the network for the new space, coordinate with your landlord and internet provider, and move everything over a weekend.
